references.text: The preceding verse describes how the earth split open beneath their feet and prepares for the event where the earth opened up.
The continuation of the account in which they went down alive into Sheol and the earth closed over them.
A flashback to Korah's rebellion, where the earth opened up and swallowed them as a warning sign for Israel.
Moses reminds the people what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram when the earth opened up and swallowed them along with everything they owned.
The psalm recounts the event where the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and covered Abiram's company.
The earth opens its mouth to receive Abel's blood, an early example of the earth opening in connection with judgment.
Sheol opens its mouth without limit, a prophetic image of how the earth swallows the wicked.
